messages:
alex_sales: Acme verbally signed off on a 2-week hosted POC. They only need embeddings + chat generation access. Ask: can we provision a scoped hosted API key that expires after 14 days and is IP-restricted? They also want audit logs and a documented rotation plan.
jamie_se: Yep — that's standard. Couple q's: separate keys per Acme team or 1 key per POC? Also, do they want a Dedicated fallback in case throughput spikes?
morgan_support: We usually do 1 key per customer POC and 1 extra service key for our SEs. Dedicated fallback is optional — ask them. For hosted keys we can: create expiring key from Console, create via Admin API, or generate in infra and import. Audit events are toggled automatically for API keys.
alex_sales: One key for the customer; one service key for our SE. No dedicated fallback for now. Important: DO NOT share key in Slack. Send via 1Password share or our secure email.
rita_security: Security checklist: key must be scoped to only embeddings + chat endpoints, disabled for model management and account-level actions. IP allowlist to their CIDR (they gave 54.72.120.0/24). Rotation schedule: rotate at day 7 and revoke at day 14. Ensure KMS logs recorded and EKS audit tie-in on our side. Also request they sign the MSA addendum for POC data handling.
jamie_se: I'll create a key named "poc/acme/emb-chat" with TTL=14d and schedule a rotation job at day 7. I'll enable IP allowlist for 54.72.120.0/24 and enable audit retention for the POC. I'll not paste key here.
morgan_support: For ops: here's the Admin API method (replace with proper admin token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/api-keys 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"name":"poc/acme/emb-chat","scopes":["embeddings.create","chat.generate"],"expires_in":1209600,"ip_allowlist":["54.72.120.0/24"]}'
```
Response includes key id and secret. Store secret in 1Password.
jamie_se: Rotation plan (short): create replacement key via Admin API, update Acme config, validate test calls, then revoke old key. I'll run rotation at day 7 and put a revoke job at day 14 if not rotated manually.
morgan_support: Revocation API (example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/api-keys/<KEY_ID>/revoke 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Console also has a button to revoke immediately.
rita_security: Also enable event webhook to our SIEM for API_KEY_CREATE, API_KEY_REVOKE, and AUTH_FAILURE events for the POC tenant. Need retention policy noted in security questionnaire.
alex_sales: Great. After jamie creates the key, please 1Password-share with Acme primary contact and cc our SE. I'll update the security questionnaire with the rotation schedule.
deploy-bot: Key created by jamie_se at 1752003502: id=ak_live_0X8jf3... expires=1752149452 (14 days). Scope=[embeddings.create, chat.generate]. Audit=enabled.
jamie_se: Created and shared via 1Password. Sent rotation notice for day 7. I left instructions for them to call support if they need revocation earlier.
alex_sales: Thanks all. Rita — I'll attach the 1Password record id to the questionnaire. Morgan — please add the webhook config to the POC tenant today.
morgan_support: Will do, adding webhook + SIEM mapping now.
rita_security: I'll review the questionnaire once you add the record. All good from security side pending MSA addendum. :lock:
alex_sales: Closing thread — will report back if Acme requests early revocation or Dedicated fallback. :thumbsup:
